verify_detail: st that cold-launches the app and asserts button visibility will fail whenever it happens to land on cold-start index 2 or 4 (mod 5) since the last data clear — which, run repeatedly without resetting app data between runs, produces almost exactly a 60% pass rate. Fix: either reset app data (`pm clear`/uninstall-reinstall) before each test run so `prior` is always 0, or have the test account for/assert against the counter-driven state explicitly instead of assuming the button is always present.'
